methodology_flags: SUPERVISED POSITIVE-POPULATION MISMATCH (recorded, not resolved): the supervised arm's 26 definable positive landers (locked-pop b1b2 17 + MUI 6 + co-admissible MCAW 3) are NOT byte-identical to the frozen-55's 23 definable landers. Overlap = MUI 6 + co-admissible C-series; the supervised set ADDS locked-pop C301/C302/C310/C311/C401 and OMITS lineage-divergent MCAW101/201/402 (rules.sha 30982105) + some C512/C514 channel variants. Perfect alignment needs a co-admissibility ruling on the divergent MCAW landers (staging MUI/MCAW dirs also lack ground_truth.json) — NOT decided here.

WORKLOAD-UNMATCHED NEGATIVES (clean-40): clean-40 are different tasks than the attacks, so ALL z-score/discriminative gaps on this basis (ours-B1/B2 AND supervised) are confounded by target-selection structure. The C2 placebo (trees 0.74-0.81 on target-selection alone) quantifies the inflation. The confound-safe twin-based separability is non-significant (supervised McNemar vs B1/B2 p=0.39-0.58).

UNIT-OF-ANALYSIS: AIDE/Falco/STIDE are per-lander binary over all 55; ours + supervised are definable-subset detectors (write-resolved only), so their TPR denominator is 23 (ours) / 26 (supervised), not 55.
STIDE is clean-CORE-trained, not clean-40-trained (no leakage); its FPR is measured on clean-40.
verdict: On the workload-matched question NO detector cleanly separates attack from benign. On clean-40 the integrity/rule detectors COLLAPSE toward the diagonal — STIDE 1.0/0.95 (gap 0.05) fires on almost every benign run, AIDE 0.95/0.65, Falco 0.78/0.68 — high TPR bought with high benign-alarm. The z-score/discriminative detectors show a LARGER apparent gap (ours-B2 0.91/0.125=0.79; supervised 0.54/0.125=0.41) but on WORKLOAD-UNMATCHED negatives: the C2 placebo shows target-selection alone yields tree-AUC 0.74-0.81, and the honest |Δsize|/L1 rule does not gain over its confound-safe twin AUC (0.71 vs 0.77, barely above MDES 0.70). Net: apparent clean-40 separation of the anomaly arms is largely the workload confound; on the confound-safe twin basis separability is non-significant.
